query: Consider the following context: How to rationally design composition of alloys with desired properties has always been an open and challenging question, especially for high-entropy alloy (HEA) which has huge selections of composition due to the feature of multi-principal elements. Although great efforts have been made in the past decades, such as approaches based on thermo-kinetic analysis and simulations, strategies to quick determine the optimal HEA composition remain lacking. In that context, which method can be used for design intrinsically strong, ductile, and low-weight refractory HEA (RHEA) compositions, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Machine learning can be used to design intrinsically strong, ductile, and low-weight refractory HEA compositions.
generation.conditions: Large dataset of HEA compositions and properties
generation.mechanism: Optimization of composition through machine learning models
generation.predicted_outcome: Design of optimal RHEA composition with desired properties
generation.baseline: Traditional trial-and-error method or thermo-kinetic analysis
generation.boundary: Limited by the quality and size of the dataset
generation.uncertainty: Insufficient evidence to confirm the effectiveness of machine learning for RHEA design

falsification_experiment.design: Comparison of machine learning-designed RHEA compositions with traditionally designed ones
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If machine learning-designed RHEA compositions do not show improved properties compared to traditional designs, the hypothesis is falsified
